name: io.github.davidb3l/ametrite
title: Ametrite
description: Issues + knowledge base of the Sothis suite. Claude Code stdio MCP; Windows, macOS, Linux.

com.ametrite.suite: Sothis suite — Sirius Forester (foreman), Hayvenhurst (code graph), Ametrite (board), Catryna Wikinelli (docs), PingMyBell (the bell)
clients: any MCP client that speaks stdio JSON-RPC
com.ametrite.install: Prebuilt binaries on GitHub Releases (cargo-dist): amt-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.zip + .sha256, or amt-installer.ps1. Then: claude mcp add ametrite -- amt mcp
com.ametrite.projectScopeConfig: A repo-root .mcp.json with { "mcpServers": { "ametrite": { "command": "amt", "args": ["mcp"] } } } makes the server auto-discoverable to any agent that opens the repo.
com.ametrite.requires: an .ametrite/ workspace in (or above) the working directory — create one with `amt init`
